items.rationale: The diagnostic shows 41,200 ÷ 52,000 mWh = 79.2% battery capacity, below the 80% cutoff in §2.6.8, with no waiver. Sections 2.6.7 and 5.2.3 therefore exclude the examination even though it established ineligibility; €75 is the estimated gross charge if covered, below the €250 cap.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact fit §§2.6.2–2.6.3, but §2.6.8 excludes the entire unit because its measured battery capacity is below 80% and no waiver applies. If covered, the photographed €549 parts-and-labour quote supports the gross estimate for the combined repair under §7.1.10.
